info.description: This is a document to describe extension API requests to manage your IPX 800 V5.

get.description:
# X4FP object description
Extension X4FP is to perform regulation according to the different mode following our necessity. This extension is generally connected to a electric heater in order to manage the temperature until 4 zones.

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **codeExt**: Code of extension. This code is indicating on the extension with 8 characters (ex:60000001)

### Object dependancies: 
* **ioComfort**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort mode on each channel
* **ioEco**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set Eco mode on each channel
* **ioAntiFreeze**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set Stop Freeze mode on each channel 
* **ioStop**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set Stop mode on each channel 
* **ioComfort_1**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort-1 mode on each channel 
* **ioComfort_2**: Array of 4 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort-2 mode on each channel 
* **ioAllComfort**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort mode on all channels
* **ioAllEco**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set Eco mode on all channels
* **ioAllAntiFreeze**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set Stop Freeze mode on all channels
* **ioAllStop**: input IO used to set Stop mode on all channels
* **ioAllComfort_1**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort-1 mode on all channels
* **ioAllComfort_2**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to set comfort-2 mode on all channels

Extension X8R is to use 8 additional relay to control output devices.

* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)

* **codeExt**: Code of extension. This code is indicating on the extension with 8 characters (ex:20000001)

### Object dependancies:
* **ioLongPush**: Array of 8 states to indicate state of each longpush channel 
* **ioOutput**: Array of 8 states, set "on", "off" or "toggle" to control each output channel 
* **ioOutputState**: Array of 8 states to indicate state of each output channel

get.description:
# X4VR object description
Extension X4VR is to used control until 4 roller shutters (or BSO) with a feedback of position. It's possible to pilot manually the 4 roller shutters (or BSO) with 4 modes.

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **codeExt**: Code of extension. This code is indicating on the extension with 8 characters (ex:50000001)
* **mode**: Modes is used to control X4VR with different ways according to this enumeration :
  * VR-PUSH_BUTTON = 0,
  * VR-SWITCH = 1,
  * BSO-PUSH_BUTTON = 2,
  * BSO-SWITCH = 3,
  * VR-UNIQUE_PUSH_BUTTON = 4
* **pulseTimeBso**: Array of 4 times to control duration of BSO pulse in 1/100 second
* **fineGapAdjust**: Value to adjust the time to close of roller shutters
* **calibration**: If it's enable send calibration of the 4 roller shutters
* **degradeModeEnabled**: If it's enable the 4 four roller shutters time (up and down) is according to [timeToOpen] and [timeToClose]
* **timeToOpen**: Array of 4 time to open in second. Is ignored if [degradeModeEnabled] is false.
* **timeToClose**: Array of 4 time to close in second. Is ignored if [degradeModeEnabled] is false.

### Object dependancies:
* **ioCommandBsoUp**: Array of 4 states, set "on" or "toggle" to send pulse time BSO UP
* **ioCommandBsoDown**: Array of 4 states, set "on" or "toggle" to send pulse time BSO DOWN
* **ioCommandUp**: Array of 4 states, set "on" or "toggle" to send command UP to each channel
* **ioCommandDown**: Array of 4 states, set "on" or "toggle" to send command DOWN to each channel
* **ioCommandStop**: Array of 4 states, set "on" or "toggle" to send command STOP to each channel
* **anaPosition**: Array of 4 values to send command to each channel in % [0..100]
* **anaCommand**: Array of 4 position value to each channel

get.description:
# X400 object description
Extension X400 is used to measure all sensors values and current values.

X400 is defined at object creation (POST) via and cannot be modified later, available functions are listed below:
* x400 CT
* x400 Ana

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **nbChannel**: Nb channels of X-BDRIGE extension. This value must be unique between all X400, and the range is [0..4].
* **func**: Function of X400 (this field is required on POST to set object function)
* **caliber**: Caliber value of current clamp. This field appears if [func] is equal to x400 CT

### Object dependancies:
* **anaOutputVal**: Array of 4 ADC values (X400 ANA) or 4 Current values (X400 CT). To keep the real value you can link this ANA with an object function in x400 Ana function.

get.description:
# XDIMMER object description
Extension XDIMMER is used to control the light intensity of devices containing lights (Halogen or Led).

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **codeExt**: Code of extension. This code is indicating on the extension with 8 characters (ex:0A000001)
* **minLvlLed**: Minimum level for the led mode according to [typeCh(1..4)], and the range is [0..100]
* **maxLvlLed**: Maximum level for the led mode according to [typeCh(1..4)], and the range is [0..100]
* **minLvlHalo**: Minimum level for the halogen mode according to [typeCh(1..4)], and the range is [0..100]
* **maxLvlHalo**: Maximum level for the halogen mode according to [typeCh(1..4)], and the range is [0..100]
* **typeCh1**: Type of channel 1, false: halogen mode and true: led mode
* **typeCh2**: Type of channel 2, false: halogen mode and true: led mode
* **typeCh3**: Type of channel 3, false: halogen mode and true: led mode
* **typeCh4**: Type of channel 4, false: halogen mode and true: led mode

### Object dependancies:
* **ioOn**: Array of 4 states, set "on","off" or "toggle" to switch on/off each channel
* **ioOnAll**: set "on","off" or "toggle" to switch on/off all channels
* **anaSpeedTransition**: value to set transition speed (time to set switch on/off the light), and the range is to  [0..64] (in second)
* **anaCommand**: Array of 4 values to set new value of each channel, and the range is [0..100]
* **anaPosition**: Array of 4 values representing position value of each channel, and the range is [0..100]

get.description:
# XDISPLAY object description
Extension XDISPLAY is used to control different functions (heating, roller shutters, Light switch ...).

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **codeExt**: Code of extension. This code is indicating on the extension with 8 characters (ex:0B000001)
* **autoOff**: The autoOff field is used to set extinction time of XDISPLAY screens? and the range is [0..60] (in minutes)
* **sensitive**: The sensitive field is used to set the sensitivity of the touch, and the range is [0..25]
* **screensType**: Array of 32 types to configure each screen corresponding to this enumeration:
  * Thermostat = 1,
  * Light switch = 2,
  * Home = 3,
  * Roller shutter = 4,
  * Date = 5,
  * Night light = 6,
  * Temperature = 7,
  * Humidity = 8,
  * Luminosity = 9

### Object dependancies:
* **ioOnScreen**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to switch on/off screen
* **ioLockSet**: set "on", "off" or "toggle" to lock "set" touch
* **anaSelectScreen**: value to select screen number
* **screenRef**: Array of ID for dependencies (IO, ANA) or object (thermostat, X4VR) according to [screensType] for each screen:
  * type 1 = ID of component Thermostat,
  * type 2 = ID of IO,
  * type 3 = ID of IO,
  * type 4 = ID of extension X4VR + refer the [nbchannelVr] at the same position,
  * type 5 = ID of IO,
  * type 6 = ID of IO,
  * type 7 = ID of IO,
  * type 8 = ID of IO,
  * type 9 = ID of IO,
* **nbchannelVr**: Array of number [0..3] corresponding to channel of X4VR extension. Number of channel is ignored if in array [screenRef] the ID group is not a X4VR and in array [ioSelectScreen_id] type is not a type 4 (Roller shutter)
* **strScreenName_id**: Array of 32 outputs STRs containing name of each screen

get.description:
# XDMX object description
Extension XDMX is used to control different devices (Lights, show equipments ...). Extension is composed of 512 channels dispatch in 64 XDMX objects of 8 channels.

### Object internal configuration:
* **_id**: Unique ID of object 
* **name**: Name of object (used for dependencies auto-name)
* **errorStatus**: Error code according to object auto check: dependencies, configuration values, etc. (0 if OK) 
* **idxChannel**: Define index of the first channel [0..511].
* **nbChannel**: Define number of channels, and the range is [0..8]. 

### Object dependancies:
* **anaInputCommand**: Array of 8 values to set new value of each channel. Value is generating automatically when [nbChannel] is set.
* **anaSpeedTrans**: Array of 8 values to set transition speed of each channel. Value is generating automatically when [nbChannel] is set.
